items.title: The property of being pro-isomorphic to a Deligne system satisfies 2-out-of-3 along distinguished triangles
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: For an open immersion j : U -> X of Noetherian schemes and an inverse system of distinguished triangles K_n -> L_n -> M_n -> K_n[1] in D^b_Coh(O_X), the lemma asserts that if (K_n) and (M_n) are pro-isomorphic to Deligne systems then so is (L_n) (statement lines 8235-8281). Since (K_n|_U) and (M_n|_U) are essentially constant with values K and M, Derived Categories, Lemma labelled derived-lemma-essentially-constant-2-out-of-3 shows that (L_n|_U) is essentially constant with value L (proof lines 8243-8250). For an arbitrary N in D^b_Coh(O_X) the proof writes the commutative diagram with rows the colimits of Hom_X(-, N) and the Hom_U(-, N|_U) groups (proof lines 8252-8268); by Lemma labelled lemma-lift-map and the invariance of colimits under pro-isomorphism the vertical arrows two to the right and two to the left of the middle one are isomorphisms, so the 5-lemma makes the middle vertical arrow an isomorphism as well (proof lines 8270-8276). Taking a Deligne system (L'_n) whose restriction to U has constant value L, which exists by Lemma labelled lemma-extension-by-zero, one gets the same colimit of Hom_X(L'_n, N), so the pro-systems (L_n) and (L'_n) are pro-isomorphic by Categories, Remark labelled categories-remark-pro-category-copresheaves (proof lines 8278-8281). Reducing the pro-isomorphism statement to an equality of colimits of Hom and applying the 5-lemma to the resulting diagram of long exact sequences is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
